headline: Update BankSettings default currency to SEK and daily transfer limit to 5,000 EUR
summary: Changes BankSettings.DefaultCurrency from EUR to SEK and halves BankSettings.DailyTransferLimit from 10,000 to 5,000 EUR equivalent. Account opening, payments, and related launch verification paths consume these updated settings.
business: New accounts opened without an explicit currency now default to SEK instead of EUR. All customers face a halved daily transfer limit of 5,000 EUR equivalent.

reasons.text: No behavioral tests verify the 5,000 EUR daily transfer limit enforcement
reasons.claim: The requirement specifies that the cumulative daily transfer limit check must enforce 5,000 EUR equivalent, allowing transfers at 5,000.00 and rejecting transfers at 5,000.01 or cumulative overruns. The test suite only asserts the property on BankSettings directly and does not test transfer limit enforcement behavior or boundary conditions.
reasons.suggested_fix: Add integration/behavioral tests using the transfer service with BankSettings to assert that transfers up to 5,000 EUR equivalent succeed and transfers exceeding 5,000 EUR equivalent (including cumulative daily transfers) fail with daily limit validation errors.
reasons.say: Without real transfer tests, customers could bypass the new 5,000 EUR daily limit and breach compliance rules. Ask the author to add behavioral tests covering exact 5,000.00 and over-limit transfers.
reasons.say_facts: The test suite only asserts the property on BankSettings directly and does not test transfer limit enforcement behavior or boundary conditions. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.text: Unsupported currency test catches generic Exception instead of specific domain exception
reasons.claim: Customer_opening_account_with_unsupported_currency_is_rejected uses Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception>, which risks passing on unintended runtime faults such as NullReferenceException rather than validating business rule rejection.
reasons.suggested_fix: Replace Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception> with Assert.ThrowsAsync<TException> specifying the exact exception type thrown for unsupported currency validation.
reasons.say: The unsupported-currency test accepts any crash instead of a proper business rejection, potentially hiding bugs during account opening. Ask to assert the specific validation error in Customer_opening_account_with_unsupported_currency_is_rejected.
reasons.say_facts: Customer_opening_account_with_unsupported_currency_is_rejected uses Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<Exception>, which risks passing on unintended runtime faults such as NullReferenceException rather than validating business rule rejection. Decide whether it must be fixed now.

reasons.text: Reviewer asks a human to check What
reasons.detail: Requirement match is partial: The configuration properties on BankSettings were updated correctly, but the requirement that all existing modules and tests continue to pass after updating obsolete assertions was not met, as the test suite is failing.
reasons.say: The test suite is currently failing, meaning unrelated customer features or existing rules may be broken. Check the failing test results and ask the author to fix them before signing.
reasons.say_facts: The reviewer is not sure the change does everything the requirement asks. Compare the change with the requirement.

reasons.text: Reviewer asks a human to check Where
reasons.detail: Tier HIGH → full human read and 2 sign-off(s) required
reasons.say: This change affects critical bank settings and is rated high risk, meaning customer accounts and money flows are impacted. Perform a full line-by-line review and ensure two sign-offs are recorded.
reasons.say_facts: The change touches a sensitive part of the bank. Check that only the intended places changed.

reasons.detail: Currency of a new account when the customer does not choose one.
reasons.say: New customer accounts without a chosen currency will now default to SEK instead of EUR. Confirm this matches the Swedish launch plan and verify customer-facing defaults are accurate.
reasons.say_facts: A bank-wide value changes: DefaultCurrency goes from "EUR" to "SEK". Small in code, but it affects every customer who uses it. Confirm the business owner approved this.

reasons.detail: Most a customer may send in outgoing payments per calendar day (UTC), in EUR equivalent.
reasons.say: All customers will be capped at 5,000 EUR equivalent in daily outgoing payments instead of 10,000 EUR. Confirm this tighter limit is approved for all customers and support teams are notified.
reasons.say_facts: A bank-wide value changes: DailyTransferLimit goes from 10_000m to 5_000m. Small in code, but it affects every customer who uses it. Confirm the business owner approved this.

reasons.text: Not checked at this coverage level: Requirement
reasons.say: Not checked (switched off by the team's coverage level, or did not run): Requirement. Not counted as passed; trust cannot be High.
